basic_details.job_title: IMU Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Maritime University (IMU), Kolkata Campus has invited applications for a Junior Research Fellow (JRF) on a sponsored research project funded by the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways (MoPSW), titled "Development of AI-based Bio-inspired AUV System for Eco-friendly Hull maintenance and Inspection". The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, for a maximum of 3 years or till completion of the project tenure (whichever is earlier), with a stipend of Rs. 37,000/- + HRA (Years 1–2) and Rs. 42,000/- + HRA (Year 3). content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification, as printed in the notice, requires both of the following: B.E./B.Tech. in Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or allied branches; or Computer Engineering or allied branches; Electrical and electronics Engineering or allied branches, AND M.E./M.Tech. in Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or allied branches; or Computer Engineering or allied branches; Electrical and electronics Engineering or allied branches. Desirable qualifications: Knowledge of mechanical system design, ANSYS/CFD, AutoCAD, AI and IoT modelling, simulation, experimental fabrication, and experimental analysis. Research publications in peer-reviewed journals indexed in Scopus and/or Web of Science (WoS). Eligibility queries can be sent to the Principal Investigator using the contact details in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice does not print the HRA amount. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project tenure, for a maximum of 3 years or till completion of the project (whichever is earlier). The JRF is initially posted for 6 months and extendable depending on satisfactory performance and availability of funds. Selected candidates are eligible to register for a Ph.D. degree at IMU as per institute rules.

content_sections.heading: IMU Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the job nature as: Numerical design and ANSYS/CFD simulation AI and IoT modelling Design and fabrication Procurement of equipment Experimental analysis

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IMU Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Complete the application form given at the end of the notification (name, parent's name, date of birth and age, category, gender and marital status, email and contact number, correspondence address, education, experience, other relevant information, declaration with signature and a recent passport size photo). Combine the application form, the Bio-data/CV and the scanned copies of all education certificates in a single PDF file. Email the PDF to [email protected] . The notice gives the submission mode as soft copy through email and Google form ( https://forms.gle/5YqfCfeJQ2VAQC4Y9 ). Send the application so that it reaches by 28 December 2026. Contact: Dr S Babu (Principal Investigator), Associate Professor, School of Marine Engineering and Technology, Indian Maritime University, Kolkata Campus; Cell No.: 9865808756; [email protected] . Completed application form with a recent passport size photo affixed Brief resume/curriculum vitae/bio-data Scanned copy of all education certificates

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview (offline/online) and intimated by e-mail. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the offline interview. The decision of the selection committee will be final. The notice does not give interview dates or describe the shortlisting method.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IMU JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date is 28/12/2026. The notice says it is extendable if desired applications are not received.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for the IMU JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need B.E./B.Tech. AND M.E./M.Tech. in Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or allied branches; or Computer Engineering or allied branches; Electrical and electronics Engineering or allied branches.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the IMU JRF post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 30 years for GEN/GEN-EWS, 33 years for OBC-NCL and 35 years for SC/ST/PwD, as on 1st October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the stipend of the IMU JRF?
faq.answer: The stipend is Rs. 37,000/- + HRA for Years 1–2 and Rs. 42,000/- + HRA for Year 3.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the stipend?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice prints the stipend as Rs. 37,000/- + HRA (Years 1–2) and Rs. 42,000/- + HRA (Year 3). The HRA amount is not printed.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the IMU JRF post?
faq.answer: Complete the application form given at the end of the notification, add the Bio-data/CV and scanned education certificates in a single PDF file, and email it to [email protected]. The submission mode is soft copy through email and Google form.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for the IMU JRF post?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates are called for an interview (offline/online) and intimated by e-mail. The decision of the selection committee is final.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IMU JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project tenure, for a maximum of 3 years or till completion of the project (whichever is earlier).

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the offline interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can the JRF register for a Ph.D. at IMU?
faq.answer: Selected candidates are eligible to register for a Ph.D. degree at IMU as per institute rules.
